passages.text: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
passages.sermon:
The nations are angry.
The peoples make plans.
Their plans are empty.
Their anger leads nowhere.
passages.original: לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ־ רִֽיק׃

passages.text: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
passages.sermon:
The kings of the earth take their stand.
The rulers gather together.
They unite against the LORD.
They unite against His Anointed One.
They say, “Let us break Their chains.”
They say, “Let us cast away Their cords from us.”
passages.original: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ׀ מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־ יָ֑חַד עַל־ יְ֝הוָה וְעַל־ מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃ נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת־ מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃

passages.text: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
passages.sermon:
God sits in heaven.
God rules over all.
God laughs at the nations and their rulers.
The Lord mocks those who oppose Him.
God is not threatened by their plans.
passages.original: יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג־ לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
passages.sermon:
God sits in heaven.
God becomes angry with the kings and rulers.
God speaks to them in His anger.
God terrifies them in His fury.
God says, “I have installed My King.”
God places His King on Zion.
Zion is God’s holy mountain.
passages.original: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃ וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר־ קָדְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD speaks a decree.
I will tell you what the LORD said to Me.
The LORD said to Me, “You are My Son.”
The LORD said, “Today I have become Your Father.”
passages.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His Son.
God says, "Ask Me."
I will give You the nations.
The nations will belong to You.
I will give You the ends of the earth.
The whole earth will be Your possession.
passages.original: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His Son.
God gives His Son authority over the nations.
You will rule the nations with a strong, iron scepter.
You will break them with this scepter.
You will shatter them completely.
They will break like clay pots.
passages.original: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
passages.sermon:
Kings, listen carefully.
Kings, seek wisdom.
Judges of the earth, accept correction.
Judges, learn from instruction.
passages.original: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Serve the LORD.
Serve Him with fear.
Rejoice before the LORD.
Rejoice with trembling.
passages.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה׃

passages.text: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
The Son is His chosen one.
Honor the Son.
Show respect to Him.
If you do not honor Him, He may become angry.
If He becomes angry, you may perish because of your rebellion.
His wrath can burn quickly.
All who take refuge in Him are blessed.
passages.original: נַשְּׁקוּ־ בַ֡ר פֶּן־ יֶאֱנַ֤ף׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־ יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל־ ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃
